question.value:
**Sample A** has a mass of 200 g and a volume of 100 cm³.

**Sample B** has a mass of 400 g and a volume of 200 cm³.

Predict how the density of sample B compares with the density of sample A.

selected_feedback.value: The mass doubles. Compare the mass of one cubic centimetre of each sample.
Each sample has 2 g per cm³. Explain to a partner why doubling both quantities leaves their ratio unchanged.
The volume doubles. Check what happens to the mass before comparing the samples again.
